entities.summary: Jayden Amari Scrubb is an American professional basketball player for the Selenge Bodons of the Mongolian Basketball League. He played college basketball for the John A. Logan Volunteers and was named NABC NJCAA Division I Player of the Year as a sophomore. Scrubb was selected with the 55th overall pick in the 2020 NBA draft by the Brooklyn Nets.
